layer: L6 / package-private current Graph-native model-policy harness
question: How should the current efficacy eval replace the accumulated D1-D42 wrapper chain with an automatically selected, model-specific but Graph-authoritative harness that can close known failures offline before another live measurement?
decision: Replace the current package-private eval runtime with one clean Graph-native harness whose only decision and canonical evidence authority is a Graph-owned lifecycle ledger. A versioned declarative ModelHarnessPolicy binds a model dialect profile, provider binding, campaign policy and bounded enhancement recipe set. Assigning a known model automatically resolves the frozen policy and derives an inspectable HarnessPlan; Graph admission is deterministic policy enforcement and never a per-run human approval step. Profiles describe capabilities and quirks, provider bindings mechanically lower one admitted effect, and enhancement recipes mechanically expand only pre-approved topology; none may select retry, recovery, next arm, budget, stopping, efficacy or canonical claims. The Graph independently admits the six frozen serial arms, one active effect, treatment exposure, inspection, mutation, deterministic diff/focused/public-semantic/hidden verification, bounded correction and cleanup; caller executors return bounded immutable result and usage facts. The first implementation must make the D24-D42 observed failure closure load-bearing without network use: wrong tool, premature final, length/schema rejection, exact replacement not-found/not-unique/unchanged, focused/public-semantic criterion failure, hidden-verifier failure, transport/provider rejection, replay/state drift, retry identity, conservative accounting, cleanup and atomic canonical persistence. Public semantic evidence uses actor-visible behavioral criteria only and must reject proposal-only or wrong-scope changes without expected-patch, hidden-verifier or source-string leakage. Historical D1-D42 code and artifacts remain immutable audit/replay inputs only and are not current runtime dependencies; no legacy output is generated. Model-specific policy remains in the eval/product layer and changes no GraphReFly library, public API, protocol or conformance. Qualification records causalAttribution=undetermined and efficacyClaim=none and authorizes no credential read, dispatch claim, provider/control-plane network access, spend or automatic live run; a later exact numeric live decision must bind the committed implementation and qualification.
rationale: The D42 live block improved legal mutations from zero to three of six, but still exposed repeated wrong-tool, output-efficiency and hidden-verifier failures, while the current runtime composes many historical wrappers and distributes configuration across authority and adapters. The approved profile-plus-mechanical-adapter design preserves automatic model assignment while returning lifecycle, evidence and recovery to one Graph authority. A clean current path and explicit offline failure matrix reduce charged integration debugging, let model-specific enhancements be swapped without changing common orchestration, and make the evidence usable by an AI maintainer as the single authority for subsequent harness repairs.

layer: L6 / package-private current Graph-owned provider proposal and exact tool admission topology
question: How must the D43 model-policy harness separate provider inference from exact workspace tool execution before the unconsumed D44 live authority may dispatch?
decision: Using D43 TypeScript commit eb3b23fd2b65bf1039bc287a59d27e588cdedc63, D43-v2 qualification artifact sha256:d1b4b45a10e002bd5be27043b3f34e1eb42f7b3495c193ea15f5b2ad34c84599, D43 implementation manifest sha256:9277e336506898d5035737b7c476cf0cc3c5fda178f8a6a462766196d8b86a4a and the unconsumed D44 execution authority recorded by commit ca2d387349d8607c1d5ef28f64e0209b17f80236 as the exact baseline, extend the clean current Graph-native harness so inspection and mutation are no longer phase-composite provider effects. Each phase follows a Graph-owned provider-proposal to exact-tool-admission to tool-result topology. The provider returns only one bounded proposal envelope plus usage, final-wire and retry facts. Only after Graph validates the exact phase, cardinality, named tool, allowlisted path, argument and byte bounds, workspace freshness, request/admission provenance and conservative reconciliation may the Graph admit exact local tool effects. One inspection proposal contains one to four read_file calls which Graph releases one at a time in proposal order; one mutation proposal contains exactly one replace_exact call. The executor executes only the currently admitted effect and returns one bounded immutable result; it owns no queue, evidence ledger, retry, recovery, next-arm, budget, stopping, cleanup or efficacy authority. Raw file content and replace_exact oldText/newText remain only in bounded same-process Graph-owned one-shot capabilities and never enter durable evidence. Canonical facts persist only material-free coordinates, byte counts, digests, workspace-state transitions and the exact proposal/admission/result/reconciliation chain. Graph rejects wrong phase, cardinality, tool, path, bounds, stale workspace, replay, substitution, not-found, not-unique and unchanged proposals before any mutation side effect and independently derives correction or cleanup. Mutation success continues through Graph-serial workspace_diff, focused_validation, public-semantic validation and hidden verification. D43 model-policy selection, six fixed serial arms, cold-not-censoring-warm, route, model information set, USD 6 block and USD 32 no-reset limits, D671/D675/D710 same-request same-route serial bounded retry, stopping, cleanup and frozen efficacy gate remain unchanged. D1-D42 runtime modules remain forbidden current dependencies. Complete injected no-network six-arm qualification, retry-wire identity, proposal/tool bijection, one-shot material capability, replay/substitution/state/TOCTOU, all rejection causes, cleanup, privacy, canonical replay, atomic persistence and implementation-drift QA, then freeze a new implementation manifest. After every D45 gate is green, the still-unconsumed D44 numeric execution authority may continue automatically without another approval of the same budget; no credential, claim, provider/network call or spend is authorized before qualification is committed.
rationale: D43 correctly centralizes phase, budget, retry, stopping and evidence decisions, but its admitted inspection and mutation effects carry only a named tool class and accept a terminal phase result. A real adapter would otherwise have to retain provider arguments and execute workspace tools inside that phase effect, silently regaining tool-order and evidence authority. Separating the provider proposal from each exact Graph-admitted tool action preserves the clean model-policy design, makes all model and workspace transitions observable and replayable, and prevents the next charged block from using adapter behavior that the D43 qualification never exercised.
